title: Refusal: MEMBERS_DUPLICATED
content: The member ${sortedMembers[i]} appears more than once. Category: spent. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with MEMBERS_DUPLICATED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: MEMBERS_EMPTY
content: A manifest must list at least one member identity. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with MEMBERS_EMPTY. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: MEMBERS_INVALID
content: Every member identity must be a string of at most 256 characters. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with MEMBERS_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: MEMBERS_UNSORTED
content: The member list must be stored in ascending sorted order. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with MEMBERS_UNSORTED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_MISMATCH
content: The membership root does not match the member list. Category: provenance. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with MEMBERSHIP_ROOT_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: NETWORK_MISMATCH
content: The acceptance plan was built for a different network. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with NETWORK_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: NETWORK_UNKNOWN
content: The network is not one this protocol names. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with NETWORK_UNKNOWN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: NONCE_INVALID
content: The intent must carry a nonce of 8 to 128 characters. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with NONCE_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OBSERVED_AT_INVALID
content: observedAt must be an ISO-8601 timestamp ending in Z. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OBSERVED_AT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OFFER_EXPIRED
content: The expiry height has passed; recovery is the only remaining path. Category: stale. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OFFER_EXPIRED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OFFER_OUTPOINT_DUPLICATED
content: The funded output appears at more than one index. Category: spent. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OFFER_OUTPOINT_DUPLICATED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OFFER_OUTPOINT_MISSING
content: No input spends the funded offer output. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OFFER_OUTPOINT_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OFFERED_OUTPOINT_DUPLICATED
content: The offered outpoint appears at more than one index, so one signature would answer for two positions. Category: spent. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OFFERED_OUTPOINT_DUPLICATED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OFFERED_OUTPOINT_MISSING
content: No input spends the offered output. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OFFERED_OUTPOINT_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OPERATION_KIND_UNKNOWN
content: The operation kind is not one this protocol names. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OPERATION_KIND_UNKNOWN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPOINT_DUPLICATED
content: The attached outpoint appears at more than one index. Category: spent. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPOINT_DUPLICATED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPOINT_INVALID
content: The record must name a lowercase txid and vout. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPOINT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPOINT_NOT_SPENT
content: No input spends the attached outpoint. Category: spent. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPOINT_NOT_SPENT. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPUT_DESCRIPTION_INVALID
content: Output ${i} needs an exact script and value, a role, and who receives it. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPUT_DESCRIPTION_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPUT_ROLE_UNKNOWN
content: Output ${i} does not name a recipient, change, or preserve role. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPUT_ROLE_UNKNOWN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPUT_SCRIPT_INVALID
content: Output ${i} does not carry lowercase hex script bytes. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPUT_SCRIPT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPUT_SET_CHANGED
content: The signed transaction carries a different set of outputs than the manifest presented. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPUT_SET_CHANGED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPUT_VALUE_INVALID
content: Output ${i} does not carry an exact decimal value. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPUT_VALUE_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: OUTPUT_VALUE_UNKNOWN
content: Output ${i} has no readable value, so the sat range cannot be traced. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with OUTPUT_VALUE_UNKNOWN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PAYLOAD_INVALID
content: The payload must be an object. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PAYLOAD_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PLAN_DIGEST_MISMATCH
content: The signed result was not produced from this plan. Refresh the plan and sign again. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PLAN_DIGEST_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: POLICY_SIGNATURES_MISSING
content: A valid acceptance carries exactly one signature from each independent policy signer. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with POLICY_SIGNATURES_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PREVIOUS_DIGEST_FORBIDDEN
content: Version 1 cannot name a previous manifest. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PREVIOUS_DIGEST_FORBIDDEN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PREVIOUS_DIGEST_REQUIRED
content: A manifest after version 1 must name the manifest it supersedes. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PREVIOUS_DIGEST_REQUIRED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PROOF_MALFORMED
content: Every proof step needs a sibling digest and a position. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PROOF_MALFORMED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PROTECTED_ASSET_MISPLACED
content: Asset ${key} was not part of the presented plan at all. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PROTECTED_ASSET_MISPLACED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PROTOCOL_FAMILY_UNKNOWN
content: The protocol family is not one this registry names. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PROTOCOL_FAMILY_UNKNOWN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED
content: The manifest protocol version must be 1.2 or a later 1.x. Category: capability. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: PURPOSE_MISSING
content: The manifest must state in one line what the transaction is for. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with PURPOSE_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: QUANTITY_INVALID
content: quantitySats must be an exact decimal string of atomic units. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with QUANTITY_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: REASON_REQUIRED
content: The revocation must state a reason of at most 500 characters. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with REASON_REQUIRED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: RECEIVE_SCRIPT_INVALID
content: The maker receive script must be lowercase hex bytes. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with RECEIVE_SCRIPT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: RECOVERY_BEFORE_EXPIRY
content: The locktime is below the expiry height. Category: stale. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with RECOVERY_BEFORE_EXPIRY. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: RECOVERY_LEAF_MISMATCH
content: The recovery leaf must be lowercase hex bytes. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with RECOVERY_LEAF_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: RECOVERY_OUTPUT_WRONG
content: A recovery pays one output, the buyer receive script. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with RECOVERY_OUTPUT_WRONG. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: REQUIRED_SIGNATURE_MISSING
content: Input ${i} is still unsigned; the result is incomplete. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with REQUIRED_SIGNATURE_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: REQUIRES_INVALID
content: The intent must require at least one exact asset with a minimum quantity. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with REQUIRES_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: REVERTED_EVENT_REQUIRED
content: A reverted event must name the event id it reverses. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with REVERTED_EVENT_REQUIRED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: RUNE_INPUT_MISSING_ALLOCATION
content: Input ${i} carries no rune allocation. Category: rune. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with RUNE_INPUT_MISSING_ALLOCATION. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SAT_FLOW_SHORTFALL
content: No output absorbs the start of the attached outpoint range; the attachment would be lost. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SAT_FLOW_SHORTFALL. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED
content: The manifest schema is not ordex.collection-manifest/v1. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SCRIPT_CHANGED
content: Output ${i} no longer pays its presented script. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SCRIPT_CHANGED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SECRET_INVALID
content: The subscription secret must be a nonempty string. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SECRET_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SELLER_OUTPUT_MISSING
content: No output exists at index ${n}, the index the seller signed. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SELLER_OUTPUT_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SELLER_SCRIPT_MISMATCH
content: The output at the seller index does not pay the signed script. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SELLER_SCRIPT_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SELLER_VALUE_MISMATCH
content: The seller payment is not the exact offer price. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SELLER_VALUE_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SEQUENCE_INVALID
content: The sequence must be a positive integer that never decreases. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SEQUENCE_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SEQUENCE_NOT_REPLACEABLE
content: A final sequence disables the locktime the recovery relies on. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SEQUENCE_NOT_REPLACEABLE. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SIGHASH_CHANGED
content: Input ${i} was signed with a different sighash than the plan approved. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SIGHASH_CHANGED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SIGHASH_UNEXPECTED
content: Input ${i} was signed with a sighash the manifest did not approve. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SIGHASH_UNEXPECTED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SIGHASH_UNKNOWN
content: Input ${i} names a sighash this protocol does not define. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SIGHASH_UNKNOWN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SIGNATURE_INVALID
content: The signature does not match this secret, delivery id, and body. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SIGNATURE_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SIGNATURE_MISSING
content: Input ${i} is required to sign and is still unsigned. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SIGNATURE_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SIGNATURE_ON_FOREIGN_INPUT
content: Input ${i} belongs to another party and must never be signed here. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SIGNATURE_ON_FOREIGN_INPUT. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SIGNER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH
content: The signature address is not the creator address. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SIGNER_IDENTITY_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SIGNING_INVALID
content: The plan must carry a signing object. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SIGNING_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SOURCE_VALUE_INVALID
content: sourceValueSats must be an exact decimal string. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SOURCE_VALUE_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SOURCE_VALUE_MISMATCH
content: The spent value does not match the record, so the sat range cannot be traced. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SOURCE_VALUE_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: STATUS_INVALID
content: The manifest status is not one this registry names. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with STATUS_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SUPPLY_MISMATCH
content: A FIXED supply must declare exactly the member count. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SUPPLY_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: SUPPLY_STATEMENT_INVALID
content: The supply statement must be FIXED or OPEN with an exact declared count. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with SUPPLY_STATEMENT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TAKER_BINDING_INVALID
content: A taker binding must name an address. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TAKER_BINDING_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_AMOUNT_INVALID
content: priceSats must be an exact decimal string. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_AMOUNT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_CRITERIA_INVALID
content: The criteria hash must be 64 lowercase hex characters. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_CRITERIA_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_EXPIRY_INVALID
content: expiryHeight must be a block height a node can carry. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_EXPIRY_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_HASH_NOT_COMMITTED
content: The revealed acceptance leaf does not commit to this offer terms hash. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_HASH_NOT_COMMITTED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_KIND_UNKNOWN
content: The offer kind is not one this protocol names. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_KIND_UNKNOWN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_NETWORK_UNKNOWN
content: The network is not one this protocol names. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_NETWORK_UNKNOWN. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED
content: The terms protocol version must be 1.1 or a later 1.x. Category: capability. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_RECOVERY_KEY_INVALID
content: The buyer recovery key must be 64 lowercase hex characters. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_RECOVERY_KEY_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_ROOT_INVALID
content: The collection root must be 64 lowercase hex characters. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_ROOT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED
content: The terms schema is not ordex.offer-terms/v1. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_SCOPE_FIELDS
content: An ITEM offer must name exactly one inscription id. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_SCOPE_FIELDS. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TERMS_SCRIPT_INVALID
content: The buyer receive script must be lowercase hex bytes. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TERMS_SCRIPT_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE
content: The delivery timestamp is outside the allowed clock skew. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TIMESTAMP_OUT_OF_TOLERANCE. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TRACE_ID_INVALID
content: The event must carry a trace id of at most 128 characters. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TRACE_ID_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TRACKED_ASSET_UNASSIGNED
content: Asset ${key} has no destination in the asset transitions. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TRACKED_ASSET_UNASSIGNED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TRANSITION_OUTPUT_MISSING
content: Asset ${key} names output ${transition.toOutput}, which does not exist. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TRANSITION_OUTPUT_MISSING. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TRANSITION_SAT_FLOW_MISMATCH
content: Asset ${key} declares output ${transition.toOutput}, but the sat range of input ${i} begins in a different output. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TRANSITION_SAT_FLOW_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: TRANSITION_SOURCE_MISMATCH
content: Asset ${key} declares input ${transition.fromInput} but rides on input ${i}. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with TRANSITION_SOURCE_MISMATCH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: UNCLOSED_SIGHASH
content: Every input must commit to every output (SIGHASH_ALL), or one party could move its asset without the other receiving theirs. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with UNCLOSED_SIGHASH. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: UNEXPECTED_MAKER_INPUT
content: Input ${key} spends an outpoint the intent never committed. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with UNEXPECTED_MAKER_INPUT. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: UNEXPECTED_SIGNATURE
content: Input ${i} was not part of the signing policy but carries a signature. Category: signature. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with UNEXPECTED_SIGNATURE. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: UNKNOWN_CLAIM_FAILS_CLOSED
content: Input ${i} carries an unrecognized claim (${asset.assetId}); resolve it before planning. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with UNKNOWN_CLAIM_FAILS_CLOSED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: UNKNOWN_CRITICAL_FIELDS
content: The signed result carries fields this protocol does not define: ${signed.unknownCriticalFields.join(', ')}. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with UNKNOWN_CRITICAL_FIELDS. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: VALUE_CHANGED
content: Input ${i} no longer carries its presented value. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with VALUE_CHANGED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: VALUE_NOT_CONSERVED
content: The inputs do not equal the outputs plus the declared fee. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with VALUE_NOT_CONSERVED. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: VERSION_INVALID
content: The manifest version must be a positive integer. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with VERSION_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.

title: Refusal: VISIBILITY_INVALID
content: Visibility must be PUBLIC or PRIVATE. Category: structural. Remediation: Inspect the transaction parameters and ensure compliance with VISIBILITY_INVALID. Verify outpoints, scriptPubKeys, and value conservation.
